(i) the propagator for the nonpropagating mode of the gluon condensation exhibits exponential space-time decay, and (ii) the propagator has the same light-cone singular structure as the free propagators.

(i) the Schwinger mechanism leads to a dynamically massed gluon, (ii) the propagator of the dynamically massed gluon has a delta-function light-cones singularity and exponential space-time behavior, and (iii) the propagator has no on-massshell singularities.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have obtained a space-time characterization in terms of an "order parameter" of the condensated gluon field, and that this order parameter is the source for a nontrivial space-time structure of the propagator, which is responsible for the confinement.
a condensate of zero-momentum gluons in QCD is a necessary condition to obtain a space-time picture of confinement in the Schwinger mechanism.

the Schwinger mechanism is a natural and simple mechanism for confinement, but the mechanism is a consequence of a nontrivial vacuum state and not of the gluon propagator alone.
